text.offer: The dead that trouble my lands come from Brax, the old city buried under the Cragged Mountains. I want it cleansed - and anything of value in it brought to Tos. A ghost walks the mountains outside it, a druid called Tendrath, who knows the way in. Find him.
text.progress: Tendrath haunts the Cragged Mountains, outside the ancient place where Brax lies buried.
text.complete: The Duke sent you? Akardius wants Brax for his treasury, no doubt. Still - the dead must be fought, whoever pays for it.

steps.objective: Find Tendrath in the Cragged Mountains
